raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Exuma < Greek exō (ἔξω) = outside + -ma suffix; exōma = that which is outside, a garment worn over others",
    "reading": "That which lies outside, an outer covering or threshold",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "Liddell & Scott, Greek-English Lexicon, s.v. ἔξωμα",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ex + uma; ex (Latin) = out of; uma (Portuguese) = one (feminine); ex-uma = out of one",
    "reading": "Emergence from unity, the one giving birth to the many",
    "languages": ["la", "pt", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Exuma ~ ex humo (Latin) = from the earth; humus = ground; ex humo = out of the soil",
    "reading": "Risen from the earth, chthonic birth, the buried becoming visible",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Exuma → amuxe; amuxe (Greek) = wagon, cart (ἄμαξα); reversed, exuma = amuxe",
    "reading": "A vehicle or carrier, the vessel that transports across thresholds",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "Liddell & Scott, s.v. ἄμαξα",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "E-X-U-M-A: Ex (out) + X (cross) + U (you) + M (matter) + A (alpha) — out of the cross, you become matter's beginning",
    "reading": "The crossing of spirit into material form, the incarnational sign",
    "languages": ["la", "en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "X = chi (Greek), first letter of Christos; U = vessel; M = water (mem, Hebrew); A = alpha, beginning; Exuma = Christ-vessel-water-beginning",
    "reading": "The anointed vessel of primal waters, origin of the sacred stream",
    "languages": ["grc", "he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "E=5, X=24, U=21, M=13, A=1; sum = 64; 6+4=10; 1+0=1; unity, the monad",
    "reading": "Reduction to one — the word collapses all plurality into a single point",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ex + uma; uma (Japanese) = horse (馬); ex-uma = out of the horse; the wooden horse, the hidden army",
    "reading": "A hidden force emerging from a deceptive exterior",
    "languages": ["ja", "la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  }
]
